## Problem and resulting behavior

Describe the problem and what changes for a user or operator. Link the related issue or design discussion, if any.

## Changes

Summarize the focused changes and any affected configuration, recovery behavior or documentation.

## Verification

List checks actually executed and their results. State which checks were skipped and why. Distinguish local fixtures, authenticated live verification and deployment; include relevant revision/workflow identities where applicable.

## Risks and limitations

Describe compatibility concerns, unresolved evidence or follow-up work. Keep credentials, private model contents and unrelated changes out of the pull request.
